dashboard.label: SSH Lab Investigation
dashboard.description: Educational lab. Validate ingestion, timestamps, and each search against real data. All-time range is intended for offline lab exports.

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype="soclab:sshd" "Failed password" | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}) port (?<src_port>\d+)" | where isnotnull(src_ip) | stats count as failures min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(user) as users by host src_ip | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)

panel.title: Five or more failures in one minute

search.query: index=soc_lab sourcetype="soclab:sshd" "Failed password" | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (?:invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}) port (?<src_port>\d+)" | where isnotnull(src_ip) | bin _time span=1m | stats count as failures values(user) as users by _time host src_ip | where failures >= 5 | sort 0 _time

index=soc_lab sourcetype="soclab:sshd" ("Failed password" OR "Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey") | rex field=_raw "(?<result>Failed|Accepted) (?<method>password|publickey) for (?:invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}) port (?<src_port>\d+)" | table _time host result method user src_ip src_port _raw | sort 0 _time
